tools.name: logiwa_list_low_stock_items
tools.description: Read one page of warehouse inventory lines and list the lines whose available quantity is at or below a threshold. Read only. It checks only the page you ask for; use page_index to read the next page. Logiwa: GET /v3.1/Inventory/list/i/{index}/s/{size}.

tools.name: logiwa_list_overdue_shipments
tools.description: Read one page of shipment orders due in a date range and list the orders that are past their expected shipment date, not yet shipped and not cancelled. The date is UTC. Read only. Logiwa: GET /v3.1/ShipmentOrder/list/i/{index}/s/{size} with ExpectedShipmentDate.bt.

tools.name: logiwa_fulfillment_summary
tools.description: Count the shipment orders placed in a date range and the orders shipped in a date range, optionally for one warehouse. Returns counts only, no order details. Read only. Logiwa: two GET /v3.1/ShipmentOrder/list calls with ShipmentOrderDate.bt and ActualShipmentDate.bt.
